# Strawberry (OmniStack Digital)

> Strawberry builds SaaS websites and iOS and Android mobile apps, then grows them with social media marketing. One fixed scope, one honest price, one timeline.

## What we do

- SaaS websites: marketing sites, pricing pages and onboarding for SaaS products, built to be fast, findable and to turn visitors into signups.
- Mobile apps: iOS and Android apps, cross-platform where that helps and fully native where it matters, shipped through the App Store and Google Play.
- Social media marketing: strategy, content and paid campaigns on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and X, measured in signups and installs rather than likes.

## How we work

- Every project gets one written scope, one price and one timeline before work begins. No surprise invoices.
- Social media retainers are monthly, with no long lock-in.
- A SaaS website usually takes four to six weeks. A first app release takes ten to fourteen. You get a dated plan before work starts.
- We take on a handful of clients at a time.
- You own the code, the designs, and the store and social accounts, from day one.

## Answers to common questions

- How long does a project take? A SaaS website usually takes four to six weeks and a first app release ten to fourteen, with a dated plan before we start.
- Do you build for iOS and Android? Yes, cross-platform or fully native, chosen per project with the trade-off explained in writing.
- Can you run our social media? Yes: monthly strategy, content and ads, with a report tied to signups and installs.
- What does it cost? Builds are priced after a short discovery call and the quoted number is the number you pay. Social is a flat monthly fee.
- Who owns the code and designs? You do.
